Class Board

java.lang.Object
common.util.board.Board
public class Board extends Object
Provides static helper methods to work with game boards. The rows and columns of the game board are indexed starting from zero.

    • move

      public static Position move(Position position, RelativeDirection direction)
      Returns the position obtained by moving from the specified position in the given direction. The method does not check whether the resulting position is on the game board.
      Parameters:
      position - the starting position
      direction - the direction into which a move is made
      Returns:
